notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB154, then kb/Work PB5847). The emitted CloseFiles body runs, per internal NON-SD connector, SequentialIoEmitter.EmitImplicitClose: the explicit CLOSE's own emitted sequence (EmitCloseStatement: the CLOSE scope, the plain Table 14 entry, the GR4 I-O status store of 14.9.6.4 into the FILE STATUS item) behind CobolFile.IsOpen, with no USE hook. GR9 scopes the implicit close to a connector 'that is open', so a closed connector is skipped instead of stamped '42' (its status stands), and a name the registry does not hold is a fortiori not open (never Require-thrown); an SD is excluded like every other registration/IO loop excludes it. 'Any USE EXCEPTION procedures associated with any of these files ... are not executed': the implicit reach passes no hook. Before PB5847 the close was a second, smaller one (CobolFile.CloseIfOpen, no status store) and a FILE STATUS item that outlives the program (a GLOBAL item of its container) kept the last statement's '10' where '00' is due; pb5847_cancel_implicit_close_status pins '00', the closed-file '42' that stands, and the GR4 cascade into a RECURSIVE containee of a RECURSIVE container. CancelNode closes via a transient factory instance when the slot is null (a returned RECURSIVE activation restores a NULL slot while its connectors stay open); ProgramTable.InstanceForClose completes the transient's parent chain the same way, because the status store reaches a container's GLOBAL item through it (a null parent threw). PB140's Close exception mapping means an error on one close cannot abandon the remaining closes. pb154_cancel_initial's REOPEN=00 pins close-at-CANCEL - NOTE it discriminates via Windows file locking ('30' on the leaked handle); kb/Work PB168 records the CALL-side re-registration that masks it on POSIX. A lead registered by the PB5847 implementer: a failing implicit CLOSE (only a host fault, '30') sets no EC-I-O condition, which GR9's last sentence presumes exists (no USE procedure and no WHEN phrase runs either way). GR5's EC-REPORT-NOT-TERMINATED on an implicit CLOSE is kb/Work PB5685.
